paragraphs.text: Rain chances increase for Pontotoc over the Halloween weekend, with the National Weather Service’s Thursday morning point forecast putting the chance at 30% Saturday, 60% Saturday night and 50% Sunday. The forecast was updated at 6:15 a.m. CDT Oct. 29.

For Halloween on Saturday, Oct. 31, the forecast calls for a high near 78 degrees and a chance of showers. Showers and thunderstorms are likely Saturday night, with a low around 58. Sunday’s outlook includes a chance of showers and thunderstorms and a high near 72.

Thursday and Friday remain dry in the point forecast, with highs near 80 and 81 degrees, respectively. The weekend percentages cover full forecast periods and do not establish exactly when rain will fall during any particular Halloween outing. Check the linked NWS forecast again as plans approach.
